acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Versioned transport-neutral request, event, accepted, progress, result and error envelope schemas are published.
Every envelope carries the exact immutable publisher/factory/release digest/capability/contract/profile/mode context.
Payload-bearing envelopes delegate inputs, outputs and error details to the shared PSI-43 validator port; no second payload validator is implemented.
Correlation and invocation IDs remain stable and causation references the preceding message in an observed chain.
Declared error codes are preserved and undeclared codes rejected; structured details require the declared error schema through PSI-43.
Mode-specific message shapes and observed transitions are explicit without implementing the PSI-45 state machine.
No ambient guarantees, protocol selection, durable queue claim, retry, idempotency or cancellation behavior are introduced.
Examples and machine-readable vectors are language-neutral and acceptance-traceable.
